perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Outlaw
perks.desc: Precision kills greatly decrease reload time.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Desperado
perks.desc: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Fleet Footed
perks.desc: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

perks.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
perks.desc: This weapon has increased reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.desc: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 110 from 23 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6VJFjsCdq5QckUaK2qXQn7?si=9032e578e9874dda) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing minor enemies in end-game actives, particularly when using Strand fragments. Aisha's Care is the first heavy burst frame pulse rifle that sits in the kinetic slot, as a Strand weapon, but unfortunately the trait perks are mainly PvP focussed, with it being a Trials weapon. Base stats are excellent compared to the small family of peers, and equate to 37.40m ADS range before damage dropoff, 0.39s ADS speed, 0.44s ready and 0.43s stow speed, and 2.05s reload speed. Saying that, handling and reload speed could definitely do with some help from the barrel and magazine perk slots. Slice is always useful in the first trait perk column when facing a boss, to apply Sever and reduce damage output by -40% - particularly running a Hunter. You can go all-in to Strand with Hatchling, and benefit from Strand aspect and fragment synergy for both perks - you should be getting plenty of easy crit kills to generate Threadlings, or boost damage output through Collective Action or Golden Tricorn. You have a choice of three useful origin trait, so just go with whatever suits your playstyle or current activity. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 110 from 23 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6VJFjsCdq5QckUaK2qXQn7?si=9032e578e9874dda) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing minor enemies in general activities. Aisha's Care is the first heavy burst frame pulse rifle that sits in the kinetic slot, as a Strand weapon, but unfortunately the trait perks are mainly PvP focussed, with it being a Trials weapon. Base stats are excellent compared to the small family of peers, and equate to 37.40m ADS range before damage dropoff, 0.39s ADS speed, 0.44s ready and 0.43s stow speed, and 2.05s reload speed. Saying that, handling and reload speed could definitely do with some help from the barrel and magazine perk slots. At the ranges you'll be engaging enemies, Keep Away in the first trait perk column will improve accuracy, as well as improving reload time to 1.58s. That makes it ideal to pair with Desperado, which provides an effective +33% increase in damage output. Alternatively, you can synergise with Strand fragments with Hatchling - you should be getting plenty of easy crit kills to generate Threadlings, or boost damage output through Collective Action or Golden Tricorn. You have a choice of three useful origin trait, so just go with whatever suits your playstyle or current activity. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Aisha’s Care is a slightly new archetype of the legendary pulse rifle added in with Corrasion and Nullify. Does the Trials of Osiris version stand out compared to the others? Well the best reload perk is Keep Away, and Slice does offer some greater utility in group settings lowering other enemies outgoing damage. Desperado is funky on this version of a pulse rifle, and Hatchling does give this pulse a bit of Strand synergy." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "From Trials straight into the crucible Aisha’s Care has Zen Moment or Keep Away in Column 3 paired with Moving Target, Headseeker, Golden Tricorn, or even Kill Clip for kill chaining. Depending on how you like the feel of this pulse or what environment you’re going to be going into 3v3 or 6v6 you might want different perks." Recommended MW: Range or Stability.
